name: Welcome Modal UI
description: UI interaction spec for the startup workspace picker modal.

dom.overlay: .modal-overlay (display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6); z-index:5000)
dom.modal: .welcome-modal (width:420px; max-height:80vh; padding:24px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:var(--shadow))
structure: button.welcome-btn (padding:6px 14px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px)
.welcome-recent-item (display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 6px; cursor:pointer; hover:background:var(--panel); border-radius:4px)
.welcome-recent-item-remove (button, × char, background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; color:var(--red))

interactions.name: open_workspace
interactions.action: IPC workspace:select (native directory picker) → resolve(path) → close modal
interactions.result: App loads workspace at selected path

interactions.name: recent_click
interactions.action: If path exists (verified via IPC fs:readDir): close(path) → loadWorkspace(path)

interactions.name: recent_remove
interactions.action: IPC workspace:removeRecent(path) → remove item DOM → hide container if no items left

states.default: Overlay visible, recent list populated from IPC workspace:getRecent
states.missing_recent: Path shown with .welcome-recent-item-missing class, click disabled, opacity reduced
